scientific_alignment.transport: Common fixed sequence of directed opportunities; at most one frame per slot; all receive-generated control/ACK outputs queue; terminal drain cannot transmit new replies.
scientific_alignment.capture: Both owners are captured separately before opportunity 1 after opportunity0 network actions. Native oracle owns a complete decoded/re-encoded session record and initial traffic seeds; assertions exclude pending next-rekey entropy at this fixed cut. Reference captures preserve their pending private keys.
scientific_alignment.predictor: Independent HMAC-SHA256 HKDF implementation reconstructs exact actual message keys. Native candidates decrypt real emitted ciphertexts; altered seed must fail actual AEAD. Neither predictor interface receives future honest private state or RNG.
scientific_alignment.common_denominator: Offered, committed, delivered and uncommitted FIFO requests are distinct. Snapshot exposure uses post-cut admitted requests; stalled/unadmitted requests are not classified as recovered messages.
scientific_alignment.baseline_envelope: Reference component returned-state boundary remains explicit; a separate actual-key AEAD audit measures a complete public envelope. Native journal commit and reference returned state are not collapsed into one durability metric.
scientific_alignment.persistence: Native image revision increments and actual counting-backend sync_data calls are measured after activation. Reference serialized-state returns are logical operations; absent physical disk metrics are null.
scientific_alignment.empirical_scope: One specified passive snapshot predictor and fixed scripted schedules; not_derived is a predictor result. The accepted computational theorems retain their own games.

resolved_findings.resolution: schedule.verify_trace binds owner+logical identity to exact immutable bytes and rejects the concrete changed-retry counterexample.
decrypt_candidate verifies candidate-key plaintext recovery on actual native ciphertext and wrong-seed AEAD rejection.
validator derives retransmissions from repeated owner+logical identities for application, control and ACK; piggyback control-body repeats remain a separate reference metric.
Suspended and RekeyRequired each emit explicit admission_blocked events without removing queued requests.
Raw-key assert_eq/assert_ne were replaced by fixed-message boolean assertions. Raw keys and captured records have no public trace/log serialization path in the added module/runner.

Selected source archive includes all root Cargo workspace members and native/reference dependencies. Test instrumentation occurs only in the isolated copy.
